_comment: Read by scripts/make_mesh.py, scripts/house_patches.py and scripts/make_case.py. The values are the solved runs'. Metres, kelvin, kg/s, watts. x east from the west wall, y up from the floor, z north from the front wall.
_solids: x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1, written as one closed STL, their union, by make_mesh.py: the wall between the living room and the hall with the lintel over its 1.0 m opening; the living room's wall to the kitchen with the lintel over its 1.6 m opening; the bedroom closet and the furnace closet, filled; the walls either side of the bath; the back hall wall with the lintels over the bedroom's and the bath's doors, and the spare room's shut door, solid from 0.05 m up. Each box runs 0.1 m past the house's outer faces where it meets them, so that the castellated mesh cuts it cleanly
_refinement: snappyHexMesh's refinement boxes (template/mesh/system/snappyHexMeshDict, written from these): level 1 (5 cm) over each register, level 2 (2.5 cm) round the gap under the spare room's door, on 10 cm background cells
_registers: x, z of each floor register's centre; each is the floor's faces within 0.15 m in x and 0.05 m in z, 0.30 x 0.10 m (12 x 4 in), 0.03 m2, blowing straight up
_windows: x0 x1 y0 y1 of each window in the front (z = 0) and back (z = 8.8) walls: living room x 2, kitchen, bedroom and spare room 1.0 x 1.2 m, the bath's 0.8 x 0.6 m
_openings: the faceZones the monitor sums the flow over: axis (0 x, 2 z), position, the opening's span along the other horizontal axis, and its height; the gap under the spare room's door 0.8 x 0.05 m, the bedroom's and the bath's doors 0.8 x 2.0 m, the hall's opening to the living room 1.0 x 2.1 m, the kitchen's 1.6 x 2.1 m; every zone is oriented along -z (or -x for the kitchen), so plus is out of the back rooms (or the kitchen) and minus into them
_rooms: x0 x1 z0 z1 of each room, floor to ceiling; 'rest' in the monitor is the whole house but the spare room's box, the air in the openings included. The layers are y < 0.2 (ankles), 0.9-1.2 (seated), 1.5-1.8 (head) and > 2.2 m (ceiling)
_runs: each register's mass flow in the order of 'registers', and the supply temperature, from the duct calculation (scripts/ducts.py, config/ducts.txt): its L/s times 1.204 kg/m3, its supply temperature in kelvin. In closed the spare room's register is a wall
_walls: storedLayerWall (src/storedLayerWall): the walls and ceiling half-inch gypsum and the floor 19 mm wood, each in 24 layers with an adiabatic back; the windows no layers, a film of 4.4 W/m2K to 20 F (-6.67 C) outside
